items.html: And it is that the angels, whose root is from Yetzira, where is the root of the six extremities and nothing more, as is known, since 'six Sefirot dwell in Metatron'; therefore the Malchut does not need to become pregnant with the souls of the angels, because she does not need them, for she already has VAK through the nursing, from which is the root of the angels, from the aspect of VAK.
